no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee Meetings or other external consultations were required.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for AKYNZEO (NDA210493). The Multidiscipline Review states that no Advisory Committee Meetings or other external consultations were required, and the filing review notes the reason was that the application is not the first in its class and did not raise significant safety or efficacy issues. Consequently there are no AdComm-driven linkages to changes in the approval.
